question: Does jointly retaining compressed callable abstractions and an observation-conditioned search guide improve later-system discovery beyond either component alone at identical online search budget?

typed_base_language.input_type: scalar expression over x in R4
typed_base_language.numeric_parameters: one fitted outer scalar callable loading per output coordinate plus a fitted 4x4 affine map; no internal numeric holes

generator.reuse: two hidden subtrees selected prospectively from recurring subtrees of the frozen base bank; acquisition programs contain them; eight later programs are new compositions of them; eight later programs are nonreuse base-bank programs
generator.outside_finite_bank: smooth random RBF callables constructed outside the declared finite AST bank and depth budget; this is not a claim of mathematical non-approximability

ambiguity: retain up to four candidates within max(1e-10, 1% of target selection energy) of the best selection MSE; compression and guide targets average uniformly across retained hypotheses

compression.criterion: expected description-length saving across at least three independently solved discovery systems; definition cost included
compression.admission: same 512-candidate search on admission observations; accept sequentially only when aggregate selection MSE is <=0.80 of the current library and solved count does not decrease; otherwise rollback

guide: ridge-linear map from permitted observation summaries to production-count targets averaged across retained hypotheses after admitted-macro substitution
online_budget: exactly 512 candidate evaluations and 512 outer coefficient fits per arm/system; no query labels, generator programs, family labels or reuse labels
abstention: best context-selection MSE exceeds max(1e-8, 10 times the acquisition-system 95th percentile); threshold frozen before later query responses
qualification: Engineered, controlled 4D Euler residual-program diagnostic. A pass supports wake/compress/guide accumulation inside a supplied finite computational language; it does not establish unrestricted equation discovery, passive trajectories, arbitrary physics, or high-dimensional scaling.
